{{Quote|Roi's millions of Rimma system fans, who had descended en masse on Recardeon for the concert, went on a rampage upon hearing that the concert had been canceled, causing several hundred thousand credits of damage to downtown property.|A news report by TriNebulon News|<ref name="Journal3" />}}
The '''Rimma system''' was located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and served as a [[Astrogation/Legends|navigational]] anchor point on the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]]. It contained the astronomical object [[Rimma]] and was ruled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Alyk Krysusten]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

The Rimma [[Star system/Legends|system]] was home to millions of fans of the [[Music/Legends|music]] of the [[Jatz/Legends|jatz]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Fitz Roi]]. Around the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[1 BBY/Legends|35:1:22]], Roi was to perform in a concert on Rimma, but his involvement in an incident at the [[Crystal Room]] of the [[Teirra Parko]] establishment in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Recardeon]] caused the Rimma officials to permanently deport the musician on the preceding [[Standard day/Legends|day]]. In response to the concert's cancellation, Roi's fans engaged in violent [[riot]]ing in downtown Recardeon.

==Description==
The Rimma system was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It served as a [[Astrogation/Legends|navigational]] anchor point on the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]<ref name="CSWE Rimma" /> [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], which connected it to the Core Worlds' [[Dentaal system/Legends|Dentaal system]] and the [[Giju system/Legends|Giju system]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Rimma [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained the terrestrial astronomical object of the [[Rimma|same name]].<ref name="Two of the Three" />

==History==
{{Quote|Jatz musician Fitz Roi ''[&hellip;]'' has once again managed to bring his concert tour to a blasting halt when his latest exploit resulted in immediate expulsion from Rimma, where he was due to perform in a concert the following morning.|A news report by TriNebulon News|<ref name="Journal3" />}}
Around the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[1 BBY/Legends|35:1:22]], the famed [[Jatz/Legends|jatz]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Fitz Roi]] visited Rimma as part of his<ref name="Journal3" /> Core-wide [[Summerside Tour]] of [[Music/Legends|concerts]].<ref name="Journal4">{{JournalCite|4|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> Millions of fans of Roi's music flocked to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Recardeon]] on Rimma from all over the Rimma system. On the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] before he was to perform in a concert in Recardeon, Roi visited the [[Teirra Parko]] establishment, where another occupant of the [[Crystal Room]] issued a challenge to him. In response, the musician started firing his famous antique [[Slugthrower pistol/Legends|projectile pistols]] at the Crystal Room's fixtures in a random, uncontrolled fashion. In the ensuing chaos, several historical artifacts were either destroyed or damaged.<ref name="Journal3" />

Rimma officials responded immediately and permanently deported Roi from the celestial body, bringing his concert tour to a halt. Roi's fans, upon learning of the concert's cancellation, engaged in [[riot]]ing, which caused several hundred thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits']] worth of damage to properties in downtown Recardeon. On 35:1:22, [[TriNebulon News/Legends|TriNebulon News]] covered the Crystal Room incident in a [[Media/Legends|news]] report issued from Recardeon.<ref name="Journal3" />

==Inhabitants==
By the date 35:1:22, the Rimma system was home to millions of fans of the music of Fitz Roi.<ref name="Journal3" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alyk Krysusten]] served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the Rimma system.<ref name="CSWE Rimma" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rimma system was first mentioned in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" feature of the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 3|third issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine, which was published in [[August]] [[1994]]. The feature was authored by [[Paul Sudlow]].<ref name="Journal3" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
